description: ADO-DISCONNECT, an attempt at Set rs.ActiveConnection = Nothing: after a connection is closed, Command.ActiveConnection returns a null interface pointer; the probe binds that result and puts it by reference into the ActiveConnection of a client batch recordset opened on another connection (State, RecordCount, an edit, UpdateBatch, then ActiveConnection put back by reference and UpdateBatch again). Whether a null pointer can be bound and passed is itself the question; if not, every dependent step is recorded as skipped and ADO-DISCONNECT stays T.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
